label: Action-type vocabulary
definition: The reusable verb layer of the model. Every step of every play is typed by one of these; rules and archetype requirements attach to the type, not to the individual step.

nodes.label: Establish spacing
nodes.definition: Occupy the five designated spots of the formation before the action starts.

nodes.label: Advance pass
nodes.definition: A pass that moves the ball up the floor against pressure, splitting the press.

nodes.label: Inbound the ball
nodes.definition: Put the ball in play from out of bounds.

nodes.label: Set up the screen angle
nodes.definition: The ball handler drives the defender towards the screener's shoulder so the screen lands on the defender's path.

key: A screen set on the wrong shoulder is not a screen: it is a traffic jam

nodes.label: Set an on-ball screen (ball screen)
nodes.definition: A stationary legal screen set on the ball handler's defender.

nodes.label: Use the screen
nodes.definition: Come off the screen shoulder-to-hip so the screener's body is between you and your defender.

nodes.label: Reject the screen
nodes.definition: Refuse the screen and attack the opposite side, punishing a defence that over-commits to the screen side.

nodes.label: Snake the ball screen
nodes.definition: Keep the dribble alive after using the screen and re-attack towards the middle, stringing out the big in drop coverage.

nodes.label: Roll to the rim
nodes.definition: After screening, turn and sprint to the basket with hands ready, occupying the rim protector.

nodes.label: Short roll (roll to the elbow)
nodes.definition: Catch the ball at the elbow against a collapsed defence and play 4-on-3.

nodes.label: Pop to the perimeter
nodes.definition: After screening, space beyond the arc instead of rolling, pulling the rim protector out of the paint.

nodes.label: Slip the screen
nodes.definition: Fake the screen and cut early to the rim, punishing a defence that jumps the screen or switches aggressively.

nodes.label: Screen the screener (Spain)
nodes.definition: A third player sets a back screen on the screener before the ball screen, creating a roll-and-replace action.

nodes.label: Down screen
nodes.definition: An off-ball screen set towards the baseline, freeing a shooter on the wing or in the corner.

nodes.label: Flare screen
nodes.definition: An off-ball screen that frees a shooter going AWAY from the ball towards the corner or wing.

nodes.label: Staggered screen
nodes.definition: Two screens in a line, releasing a shooter across the top or up from the corner.

nodes.label: Dribble hand-off (DHO)
nodes.definition: The ball handler dribbles towards a teammate and hands the ball over, forcing the defence to defend a moving screen and a new ball handler at once.

nodes.label: Basket cut
nodes.definition: A hard cut to the rim, usually after a pass (pass-and-cut) or when the defender's attention leaves.

nodes.label: Backdoor cut
nodes.definition: When the defender overplays the passing lane, cut behind him to the rim for a backdoor feed.

nodes.label: Relocate
nodes.definition: After passing or screening, move to a new spot (usually lifting to the arc or drifting to the corner) to keep the spacing honest.

nodes.label: Fill the vacant spot
nodes.definition: Replace the cutter: when a teammate cuts through, the next player fills the spot he vacated.

key: Motion offence lives here: cutting without filling produces two players in one spot

nodes.label: Ball reversal
nodes.definition: Swing the ball from one side of the floor to the other, forcing the defence to re-set its shell and opening the weak side.

nodes.label: Skip pass
nodes.definition: A pass that flies over the top of the defence to the weak side, usually to the corner.

nodes.label: Pocket pass
nodes.definition: A short, late, on-target delivery to the rolling big in the window between the two defenders.

nodes.label: Lob pass
nodes.definition: A high delivery over the defence to the roll man, high-pointed at the rim.

nodes.label: Kick-out pass
nodes.definition: A pass out of penetration to a shooter relocated on the arc.

nodes.label: Dribble penetration
nodes.definition: Attack a closeout or a gap to force the defence to collapse.

nodes.label: Pull-up jump shot
nodes.definition: Shoot off the dribble, the primary counter to any coverage that goes under the screen or drops.

nodes.label: Step-back three
nodes.definition: Create space with a step-back rather than a screen: the isolation counter to switch coverage.

nodes.label: Catch-and-shoot
nodes.definition: Shoot immediately on the catch, before the defence can rotate.

nodes.label: Post up
nodes.definition: Establish position on the block or the elbow and score or pass from there.

nodes.label: Duck in / seal
nodes.definition: Seal the defender on the low block for an entry pass.

nodes.label: Lob finish
nodes.definition: High-point the lob at the rim, above the defender's contest.

nodes.label: Flash to the high post
nodes.definition: Cut to the free-throw line to catch against a zone or a rotating man defence, splitting the floor in half.

nodes.label: Crash the offensive glass
nodes.definition: Send players to the offensive boards to extend the possession and punish a defence that cannot box out.

nodes.label: Late-clock isolation
nodes.definition: Clear a side and let your best creator go one-on-one with a short clock.

nodes.label: Press attack
nodes.definition: Structured offence against a full-court press: sideline safety, middle release, advance pass.

nodes.label: Rim run (transition)
nodes.definition: Sprint the floor to the rim before the defence can set its shell.

nodes.label: Contain the ball
nodes.definition: Point-of-attack defence: keep the ball out of the middle and force a contested shot or a late pass.

nodes.label: Drop coverage
nodes.definition: The screener's defender sinks below the level of the screen to protect the rim, conceding the pull-up jump shot.

nodes.label: At the level
nodes.definition: The screener's defender meets the ball handler at the level of the screen and recovers with the roller.

nodes.label: Show and recover (hedge)
nodes.definition: The screener's defender steps out to stall the ball handler, then recovers to his own man.

nodes.label: Blitz (trap the ball handler)
nodes.definition: Both defenders attack the ball handler off the screen, forcing the ball out of his hands.

nodes.label: Switch
nodes.definition: The two defenders exchange assignments at the screen, taking away the pass to the roller.

nodes.label: Scram switch
nodes.definition: After a switch, a third defender swaps onto the mismatch (usually the big) so the smaller defender is not posted up.

nodes.label: ICE (Blue / down) coverage
nodes.definition: The on-ball defender pushes the ball handler towards the baseline, using the sideline as an extra defender.

nodes.label: Tag the roller
nodes.definition: The weak-side low man bumps the rolling big on his way to the rim, then recovers to his own man.

nodes.label: Help and recover (stunt)
nodes.definition: Show a body in the gap to slow the drive, then sprint back to your own assignment.

nodes.label: Weak-side dig
nodes.definition: The weak-side defender digs down on the ball when a post-up or a drive begins, then recovers.

nodes.label: Closeout
nodes.definition: Contest a shooter: sprint to the catch, chop the feet, hand up, and do not fly past the shot fake.

nodes.label: Rotate
nodes.definition: Move on the flight of the ball: every defender slides one spot in the direction of the pass.

nodes.label: Touch the midline
nodes.definition: Zone rule: the weak-side back-line defender must have a foot on (or past) the midline of the lane when the ball is on the strong side.

nodes.label: Bump the cutter
nodes.definition: Zone rule: displace a player cutting through your area, then release him to the next defender.

key: A bump is a momentary displacement, not a hold: the defender must give the cutter up

nodes.label: Trap
nodes.definition: Two defenders converge on the ball to force a turnover or a rushed pass.

nodes.label: Take a charge
nodes.definition: Establish legal guarding position outside the restricted-area arc and absorb the drive.

nodes.label: Go vertical
nodes.definition: Contest at the rim with arms straight up, avoiding the downward arm motion that draws a foul.

nodes.label: Rim protection
nodes.definition: Deter and contest shots at the basket from the help side.

nodes.label: Box out
nodes.definition: Find a body, make contact, then go get the ball: end the possession with the rebound.

nodes.label: Transition defence
nodes.definition: Sprint back level with the ball, protect the rim first, then find shooters.
